title: Katt Williams Claims He Inspired Steph Curry's NBA Greatness
htmlContent:
Katt Williams made a bold statement during an episode of The Good One podcast recorded live at Vulture Festival in November in an unexpected and funny conversation.
“Anybody that knows me knows that I don’t claim the shit I do,” Williams admitted. “But I am responsible for the greatest shooter in the NBA, without question.”
Williams, who is more famous for his sharp tongue than his basketball expertise, was talking about none other than Steph Curry, the superstar and NBA legend of the Golden State Warriors. The claim stemmed from a surprising chapter in Curry's early career -- his participation in celebrity basketball games organized by Williams himself. Williams narrated, pondering Curry's situation at that moment. As a standout NCAA scoring champion, Curry's talent was undeniable but not widely recognized. Williams was left with an indelible impression of Curry's shooting prowess during the games. Williams was so impressed that he offered advice to the future MVP that, in retrospect, seems prophetic.
“The NBA isn’t ready for your shooting skills,” Williams told Curry. He then shared a simple but prescient strategy: “If you can shoot before people can start defense, you’ll be the greatest shooter that ever lived.”
Williams' bold statement was delivered with the humor and flair that has made him a familiar name in comedy.“The jury will decide whether or not I’m being facetious,” As he recounted the story, he laughed. Basketball fans, comedy lovers, and even sports analysts have been discussing the anecdote. Is it possible that an encounter in a celebrity basketball game had a true impact on Curry's journey to becoming the NBA's all-time three-point leader and a four-time NBA champion? Is this just another instance of Williams's comedic genius in spinning a captivating tale? The full story and Williams' compelling case can be heard on the Good One podcast, if you're curious. Regardless of whether Williams played a key role in Curry's success, the story is an intriguing look at the intersections of sports, comedy, and destiny.
